description:
This prospectus is being issued to solicit applications for a concession campground special use permit.

A permit to provide high-quality public service in the operation and maintenance of Government-owned recreation facilities located within the Lincoln National Forest will be issued.

The offering includes approximately 20 sites that include campgrounds, group campgrounds, picnic areas, a day use site, and an equestrian campground. The three-year average gross revenue for this offering is $222,888.53.
